repo_purpose: Offline-first Python CLI for scanning, classifying, and recovering damaged visual media with SQLite evidence tracking, JPEG-focused repair strategies, baseline image/video recovery, optional FFmpeg-assisted salvage, and JSON/CSV reporting.

truth_order: current source, tests, package/build configuration, and live repository state

source_areas.role: CLI parser, arguments, dispatch, run startup, summary printing
scan, classify, recover, score, write outputs, persist recovery evidence
input iteration, byte reads, hashing, declared kind, file records
family, label, confidence, and classification evidence
candidate generation via jpeg-v1 and baseline-v2
Pillow and FFmpeg/ffprobe probing, saving, remuxing, previews, frames, output hashes
SQLite schema, migrations, persistence, summaries, attempts
JSON summary and attempts CSV export
local workspace layout and config snapshots
historical source evidence, not current behavior authority

test_areas.coverage: signature detection for prefixed MP4 data
run summaries, duplicate candidate persistence, successful output summaries
JPEG recovery strategies, candidate generation, standard color tables, FFmpeg-gated prefixed MP4 recovery

cli: file-uncorrupter benchmark input output --recursive --all-files --db runs.sqlite3 --output-json benchmark.json --output-csv attempts.csv

work_management.delivery_flow: Issue -> branch -> implementation -> verification -> pull request

safety_rules: Preserve existing runtime behavior unless explicitly asked to change it.
Preserve unrelated dirty and untracked work; do not reset, stash, discard, or overwrite it.
Treat source, tests, package/build configuration, and live repository state as higher-priority truth than docs and archives.
Treat input media as hostile and keep source evidence separate from output, database, report, raw-candidate, and workspace paths.
Do not add secrets, credentials, private paths, private media details, account identifiers, private URLs, or .env contents.
Do not merge, deploy, publish, release, tag, or change repository settings without explicit authorization.
Record exact blockers when validation cannot be run.
sensitive_path_rules: Keep .agents/ and .specify/ local-only unless a repository decision changes that.
Do not treat generated recovery outputs, SQLite databases, JSON/CSV reports, or raw candidates as anonymized public artifacts.
